§6RF Lux§f

§aLights that don’t look like you raided a dungeon for glowstone.§f
§9RF Lux§f gives you clean, configurable lighting with optional redstone control. Three tiers:

§b• Level 0§f: No power needed, glowstone-level light.
§b• Level 1§f: Larger area, §c5 RF/t§f from a §e10,000 RF§f buffer.
§b• Level 2§f: Maximum area, §c20 RF/t§f.

Available as flat panels or full blocks, with §65 color options§f each. Great for keeping your factory floors lit without looking like a torch spam incident.

Redstone control means you can hook these up to sensors and switches for automated lighting systems that turn on when you walk in and off when you leave.

§ePS:§f Check JEI for all the color and form factor variants.
